title: MultiPost Extension
description: Check the browser extension connection, then start publishing to your platforms once it is installed.
checking_description: Please wait while MultiPost confirms that the browser extension is enabled.
ready_description: The browser extension is connected and ready to publish.
install_description: Install and enable the MultiPost extension, then check the connection again.
pin_tip: After installation, click the puzzle icon in your browser's toolbar, then click the pin icon next to MultiPost to keep it easily accessible.
